# How Can I Automate a New Employee's Access Setup on Their First Day?


You automate access setup by triggering a checklist of required system and tool access the moment a hire's start date arrives, rather than assembling it manually beforehand. On **Jestor** , this runs through **Onboarding** with access-setup automation.


A new employee arriving on their first day without the system access they need to actually start working leaves that first impression wasted on IT troubleshooting instead of productive onboarding.


## What manual first-day access setup costs


- A new hire's first day spent waiting on access instead of actually working
- IT scrambling to set up access reactively once the employee has already arrived
- Inconsistency in what access different new hires get, depending on who sets it up
- A wasted first impression that could have been a productive, welcoming start


## How automated first-day access setup works


- A hire's start date triggers a required access **checklist** in advance
- Standard access requirements apply consistently to every new hire's role
- IT can complete setup before the actual start date, not reactively on day one
- The new employee arrives ready to work, not waiting on last-minute setup


## Why Jestor fits this use case


- Advance triggering removes the reactive scramble on an employee's first day
- Consistent checklists ensure every new hire gets the same appropriate access
- A ready-to-work first day makes a stronger impression than a delayed start
- This scales from occasional hiring to a company onboarding regularly


Reactive first-day setup Automated advance access setup


Wasted first day on troubleshooting Ready to work on arrival


## Frequently Asked Questions


**Can access requirements vary by role or department?** Yes, different roles can trigger different access checklists. More at[jestor.com](https://www.jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com) .


**Does this notify IT with enough lead time before the start date?** Yes, the trigger can be configured to fire ahead of the actual start date.


**Is there a record confirming all access was set up correctly?** Yes, the completed checklist stays connected to the employee's onboarding record.
